common.fallbackLink: If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
common.expires: This link expires in {minutes} minutes and can only be used for this account.
common.automated: This is an automated message from SST. Replies to this address aren't monitored.

verify.subject: Verify your email for SST
verify.preheader: Confirm your email to finish creating your SST account.
verify.heading: Verify your email
verify.body: Confirm that this email address belongs to you to finish creating your SST account.
verify.ignore: If you didn't create an SST account, you can ignore this email. No account will be activated without this confirmation.

reset.subject: Reset your SST password
reset.preheader: Choose a new password for your SST account.
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: We received a request to reset the password of the SST account linked to this email.
reset.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays the same. After a reset, every signed-in device is signed out.
